Bandwidth.description_en:
The bandwidth of the VPC peering connection. Unit: Mbit/s. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0.

A value of -1 indicates that no limit is imposed on the bandwidth.

Default values:

The default bandwidth for a cross-region VPC peering connection is 1024 Mbit/s.

The default bandwidth for an intra-region VPC peering connection is -1. This value indicates that no limit is imposed on the bandwidth
Bandwidth.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的带宽，单位：Mbps，取值范围为大于0的整数。

例外取值-1，表示无带宽限制。

默认值如下：
跨地域VPC对等连接的带宽默认值为1024 Mbps。
同地域VPC对等连接的带宽默认值为-1 Mbps，即不限制带宽

BizStatus.description_en:
The business status of the VPC peering connection. Valid values:

Normal

FinancialLocked: The VPC peering connection is locked due to an overdue payment
BizStatus.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的商业状态。取值：

Normal：正常。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

Description.description_en: The description of the VPC peering connection

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the VPC peering connection was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
GmtCreate.description_zh: VPC对等连接的创建时间。使用UTC时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

GmtExpired.description_en:
The time when the VPC peering connection expires. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format.

This parameter is returned only when the VPC peering connection is in the Accepting or Expired state. For other states, this parameter is empty
GmtExpired.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的过期时间。使用UTC时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。

只有当VPC对等连接的Status（状态）为Accepting（接收中）或Expired（已过期）时，才会返回具体的过期时间；VPC对等连接处于其余状态时，返回值为null

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the VPC peering connection was modified. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
GmtModified.description_zh: VPC对等连接的修改时间。使用UTC时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
